name: syncreel
description: Self-hosted Watch Together PWA for Plex Media Server

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@syncreel/shared && npm run build --workspace=@syncreel/server && npm run build --workspace=@syncreel/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace=@syncreel/shared && npm run typecheck --workspace=@syncreel/server && npm run typecheck --workspace=@syncreel/web
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace=@syncreel/server && npm run test --workspace=@syncreel/web
